restrictions: Generic memoryless Pollard-rho (Floyd) on f(x)=H(enc32(x)), H=complete sha3-256-r7-prefix-v1 (rounds 0..6), enc32=32-byte LE; one sponge absorption per evaluation.
At most 5*2^128 permutations plus <=64 word ops at 1/1897: T<2^130.34.
Memory < 2^16 bytes. No tables/preprocessing/advice in the claimed algorithm.

heuristics.statement: Assume first-repeat length L of f from a uniform start obeys the uniform random-mapping bounds Pr[L<=2^128]>=1-exp(-(1-2^-128)/2) and Pr[mu=0 and L<=2^128]<=2^-128. Then success>0.39 (proof.md).
heuristics.scope: Full-width f on 2^256 points; complete 7-round SHA3-256 on 32-byte messages.
heuristics.extrapolation: Organizer experiment rho-reduced: Floyd on 16-bit truncation; mask-checked. Extrapolated to 256 bits.
